description: This file is a C header file (.h) that declares interfaces related to PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) layer control functions. It includes licensing information, include guards, external C linkage, and function prototypes for enabling/disabling lower and upper layers of PPP.

methods.name: ppp_lower_layer
methods.description: Function to control the lower layer of PPP, enabling or disabling it based on the mode and parameters.

methods.name: ppp_upper_layer
methods.description: Function to control the upper layer of PPP, enabling or disabling it based on the mode and parameters.
